component: Static CSS image resource test helper

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: chromeFileExists parses the URI and selects TYPE_IMAGE for moz-icon, leaving other schemes at TYPE_OTHER. It then opens a system-principal channel and returns whether the stream reports bytes, so its result is a readable nonempty resource check. The caller uses it for CSS image references. This is scoped test setup; the upstream engine restriction, rendering and a fresh channel/CSS run remain unverified.
title: The CSS resource helper uses an image context only for moz-icon and requires readable bytes
